definition: Provocative means deliberately intended to stir a strong reaction — anger, debate, or hard thought.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word provocative. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know provocative should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Her provocative thesis — that the city's beloved bridge should never have been built — kept the lecture hall's question period running past midnight.
